name: Awaguchi Akari
source:
A quiet 2nd year high school student. Chikako's childhood friend who loves her a lot. Ten years ago, she gave Chikako a star hair ornament, and she herself wears a moon hair ornament made of the same material.

[Translated from [url=https://ahonojuge00.wixsite.com/rinjou-stargazer]official website[/url]]
